archetype.canvas.description: Elements are placed directly on an infinite plane, wrapped by a tool palette and a properties panel. Fits when the spatial arrangement itself is the deliverable.
archetype.chat-workspace.description: A pinned bottom composer and an upward-stacking conversation scroller form the axis, with the thread list and settings alongside. Fits screens whose body is the back-and-forth itself.
archetype.dashboard-grid.description: Metric cards and charts are laid out in a grid so the whole state reads in one screen. Fits when the goal is spotting anomalies fast rather than digging deep.
archetype.doc-reader.description: A single body column is narrowed to a readable width, with a document tree on the left and a table of contents on the right marking position. Fits when the goal is getting long text read to the end.
archetype.feed-timeline.description: A single chronological vertical stream is the protagonist, with filters and summaries as side branches. Fits screens that follow an open-ended flow.
archetype.sidebar-app.description: A persistent left sidebar lists every destination while the main pane fills the rest — the default app skeleton. Fits internal tools with many destinations where people stay all day.
archetype.split-pane.description: A list on the left and its detail on the right share one screen, and selecting an item swaps only the right pane. Fits screens where items are worked through one after another.
archetype.top-nav-site.description: Sections flow vertically beneath a horizontal top nav. Fits screens that explain what something is to a first-time visitor and lead to a single action.
archetype.wizard-flow.description: One step at a time, with progress showing how far is left — a linear skeleton. Fits procedural input where dropping out midway is not acceptable.

component.alert-dialog.description: A modal shown before a destructive action that requires confirmation.

component.app-logo.description: An app logo that places a Phosphor icon on a primary background tile. Shared across login and sidebar headers (ported from srope).
component.aspect-ratio.description: Locks the aspect ratio of a child element.
component.attachment.description: Previews files attached to a chat.
component.avatar-group.description: A stacked avatar group with a +N overflow badge.
component.avatar.description: Shows a user's profile image or initials.
component.badge-extended.description: A rule-enforcing component that adds success/warning/danger semantic state variants to the shadcn Badge (#21).
component.badge-with-spinner.description: A badge with a spinning indicator on the left to show in-progress state. Follows badge-extended variants (ported from srope).
component.badge.description: A small label for status or counts.
component.banner.description: An announcement bar with info/success/warning/destructive variants (dismissible).
component.breadcrumb.description: Navigation that shows the path to the current location.
component.bubble.description: A chat bubble whose style changes based on the sender.
component.button-group.description: Visually groups buttons into a single set of actions.

component.calendar.description: A calendar widget supporting single or range date selection.
component.card.description: The default card container for grouping content.
component.carousel.description: A carousel for paging through multiple items as slides.
component.category-card.description: A categorized aggregation card with icon, label, total, and a sub-item list (ported from srope).
component.chat-widget.description: A floating chat widget with a bottom-right launcher, unread badge, and a bubble/whisper/system message panel. Realtime wiring is owned by the caller (ported from srope).
component.checkbox.description: A checkbox input that supports multiple selection.
component.circular-progress.description: A pure SVG ring progress indicator (center label, size/stroke).
component.code-block.description: A code block with a copy button and line numbers (no external highlighter).
component.collapsible.description: Expands and collapses a single content block.
component.color-picker.description: A pure color picker with a preset swatch grid, hex input, and preview (no external library).
component.combobox.description: A combobox for selecting a value from a searchable list.
component.confirm-dialog.description: A confirm-only AlertDialog wrapper used before irreversible actions like delete or reset. Locks the confirm button while loading (ported from srope).
component.context-menu.description: A context menu opened via right-click.
component.contribution-bars.description: A SHAP-style contribution panel that breaks down factor contributions with track bars and percentages.
component.date-picker.description: A single-date picker combining calendar and popover.
component.date-range-picker.description: A range picker for selecting a from-to period with a two-month calendar.
component.dialog.description: A modal dialog that covers the screen.
component.direction.description: Changes alignment based on message direction (sent by me / sent by the other party).
component.dropdown-menu.description: A dropdown menu opened by clicking a trigger.
component.empty-state.description: A convenience empty-state wrapper finished with a single message/icon/subtext/action prop API (ported from srope).
component.empty.description: An empty-state screen shown when there is no data.
component.error-state.description: An error state with 3 variants: page (card + retry), inline (form box), and simple (one line) (ported from srope).
component.field.description: A form field layout primitive with label, description, and error message.
component.format-biz-no.description: A display utility that formats Korean business registration numbers as 000-00-00000 (ported from bizinfo, #8).
component.format-won.description: A utility that abbreviates KRW amounts using eok/jo (Korean number units) (ported from news FlowPanel eok(), #18).
component.gauge-card.description: A name + status badge + threshold-based gauge bar + tags/cause-tag card. Colors resolve automatically at the 60/30 thresholds (ported from srope).
component.hover-card.description: Shows a preview card on hover.
component.icon-picker.description: A popover picker that selects Phosphor icons via category tabs and combined Korean/English search (ported from srope).
component.input-group.description: Attaches icon, button, or text add-ons to an input field.
component.input-otp.description: For fixed-length inputs such as one-time passcodes.
component.input.description: The default single-line text input field.
component.item.description: A list item layout with icon, text, and actions.
component.kbd.description: An inline element for displaying keyboard shortcuts.
component.kebab-menu.description: A kebab menu where pressing the vertical three-dot (⋮) icon button opens an action dropdown. Declared with a single items array, and enforces an aria-label on the trigger via the label prop.
component.keyword-cloud.description: A keyword cloud that expresses frequency through three tiers of pill size and emphasis, expanding related items on click.
component.label.description: A label accessibly bound to a form control.
component.live-indicator.description: A real-time status indicator showing live/paused/stale/offline states with a pulsing dot and last-updated time.
component.marker.description: A marker for indicating items in a timeline or list.
component.menubar.description: A desktop app-style top menu bar.
component.mermaid-viewer.description: A diagram viewer that dynamically loads mermaid to render code as SVG. Supports code-fence stripping, dark mode, and loading/error states.
component.message-scroller.description: A container that auto-scrolls to follow new messages.
component.message.description: A component representing a single chat message.
component.multi-select.description: A component for multi-selecting via a command popover, with removable chips for selected items.
component.native-select.description: A styled version of the browser's native select element.
component.navigation-menu.description: A top navigation menu that includes dropdowns.
component.number-input.description: A numeric input with +/- steppers and min/max/step.
component.page-header.description: A page top header with the title (h1), a right-side badge/action slot, and a description (ported from srope).
component.password-input.description: A password input toggled visible/hidden with an eye icon.
component.pipeline-rail.description: A pipeline stepper that navigates process stages with a numbered-node rail and a second row of sub-tabs. Excluded stages appear dashed and disabled.
component.popover.description: A free-form content overlay that appears around a trigger element.
component.radio-group.description: A radio button group for selecting exactly one of several options.
component.rate-color.description: A utility that produces Korean-convention gain/loss color classes (gain = red, loss = blue) and signed percentage text (ported from tossinvest, #18).
component.rating.description: A star rating — supports hover preview, half stars, readonly, and value-based severity tones (built-in or custom via toneByValue).
component.region-map.description: Korean province-level distribution map — geographic choropleth (3D hover extrusion, rich tooltip) with a tile cartogram toggle (ported from bizinfo, #56).
component.relation-network.description: A pure SVG relationship network visualization that renders node/edge data as a constellation.
component.resizable.description: A panel layout resizable by dragging.
component.risk-core-map.description: A risk core network map that places risk tiers in concentric bands from center to edge, expressing exposure and risk through node size and glow.
component.scenario-simulator.description: A what-if scenario simulator where current/scenario/delta KPI cards recalculate instantly as parameters change.
component.screen-help-dialog.description: A screen manual dialog opened via a (?) button next to the screen title (ported from bizinfo, #8).
component.scroll-area.description: A scroll area with a custom scrollbar.
component.scroll-stack.description: A scroll-linked stack where cards pin to the top and pile up as you scroll. Scale, rotation and blur intensity are adjustable via props.
component.select.description: Selects a single value via a custom dropdown.
component.sheet.description: A panel that slides open from a screen edge.
component.signal-card.description: A trading signal card with stock name, verdict badge, and a 3-segment buy/hold/sell score bar (ported from srope).
component.skeleton.description: A placeholder block indicating a loading state.
component.slider.description: A slider for dragging to adjust a numeric value within a range.
component.spinner.description: A spinning indicator showing an async operation in progress.
component.stage-progress-board.descripti: A multi-stage progress board showing status badges, progress bars, and task checklists as a card grid.
component.status-card.description: A name + status badge + progress bar card — one variant drives both badge and bar colors (ported from srope).
component.summary-card.description: A dashboard KPI summary tile with icon, label, number, and unit (ported from srope).
component.switch.description: A toggle switch for on/off state.
component.table-sortable.description: A generic data grid with a fixed header and scrolling body, column sorting, drag-to-reorder rows, and column show/hide toggles (ported from tossinvest, #24).
component.table-toggle.description: An admin table with an on/off Switch on every row. Supports optimistic updates, rollback with a failure reason on error, per-row pending state, and reconciliation with incoming data (#69).
component.table.description: A table for displaying data in rows and columns.
component.tabs.description: Content panels switched between via tabs.
component.textarea.description: A field for multi-line text input.
component.toggle-group.description: Groups multiple toggle buttons to support single or multiple selection.
component.toggle.description: A single toggle button with pressed/unpressed states.
component.tooltip-icon-button.descriptio: A rule-enforcing component that forces a Tooltip and aria-label onto icon-only buttons (#21).
component.tooltip.description: Shows a short explanation on hover or focus.
component.tree-view.description: A general-purpose collapsible tree with folder/file icons and keyboard accessibility.
page.archetypes.description: If a profile fixes color and typeface, an archetype fixes the skeleton — where navigation sits and in what order information flows. Change only the skin and you get apps that differ in color but share one structure. A project picks one profile and one of the {count} archetypes below, each explicitly.
page.archetypes.howto-description: Pick the archetype first, from what the screen does; then pick the profile, from the brand's character. The two axes are independent, and a project fixes one archetype as its global standard — if the skeleton changes screen by screen, choosing an archetype means nothing.
page.archetypes.title: Layout Archetypes
page.components.badge-composition: doksam extension — a custom component composed from primitives
page.components.description: All {total} components are organized by composition layer. Primitive ({primitive}, shadcn) are the low-level building blocks provided by shadcn/ui, while Composition ({composition}, doksam) are doksam's own components built by combining those primitives. The badge on each card indicates its source.
page.components.title: Component Catalog
page.home.ai-callout-1: Just tell your AI agent to
page.home.ai-callout-3: This page provides the raw ruleset text you can paste directly into a prompt.
page.home.description: A reference that brings together shadcn/ui-based design tokens and a full component showcase in one place. For people, it's a visual guide; across multiple projects, it's a single source of truth (SSOT) for copying and reusing color, typography, and component code as-is.
page.home.install-description: doksam-ui's own components, utilities, and profiles can be installed directly via a self-hosted shadcn custom registry. The full list and install commands are AI-readable as-is at
page.home.presets-description: Use the preset chip in the top right to pick one of {presets}, the icons below to switch light/dark, and the font selector to switch typefaces. Your selection is saved in the browser and persists on your next visit. From anywhere, press
page.home.presets-description-2: to search for and jump straight to any page or component.
page.home.title: doksam Project Shared UI Standard Site
page.icons.description: The three icon standards — Phosphor, Lucide, Tabler — and their usage rules. Emoji are not used as icon substitutes.
page.icons.gallery.description: Search 250+ curated Phosphor icons by name or Korean keyword. The weight and size toggles apply to the whole grid, and clicking an icon copies its import statement.
page.icons.gallery.fullCatalogNote: For icons not listed here, find them in the full catalog at phosphoricons.com and use the same import rule (@phosphor-icons/react/dist/ssr).
page.icons.gallery.title: Icon search
page.patterns.description: A collection of screen patterns ({total} total) built by combining multiple shadcn components, rather than a single component. Common patterns are reusable as-is across any doksam project; Financial Domain patterns are specialized for financial screens like mobile banking and stock trading; Srope patterns are extensions specialized for the srope project domain.
page.patterns.title: Common UI Pattern Collection
page.profiles.description: Choosing {theme} theme presets and {font} font presets separately per project causes combinations to diverge. Profiles are a layer that locks those choices in ahead of time — projects don't pick color and font individually, they just specify one of the {count} profiles below.
page.profiles.title: Brand Profiles
page.rules.copyHint: Copy the full markdown source for AI prompts.

page.templates.description: Full app scaffolds assembled from brand profiles and standard patterns, ready to deploy as-is. Each template enforces its profile's tokens and uses the catalog's components directly.
page.templates.install-description: Each template is built solely from its profile and standard components. Catalog items are available via

page.templates.title: Templates

profile.admin.description: A profile for internal admin tools and back-office screens. Calm neutral tones that prioritize information density.
profile.console.description: Profile for monitoring and ops-console screens. Dark by default with warm orange accents, packing logs and status densely.
profile.data.description: A profile for data dashboards and market/news screens. Dark by default with high-contrast violet tones.
profile.docs.description: Profile for docs, wikis and blog-style screens. Calm green tones and generous spacing prioritize long-form readability.
profile.service.description: A profile for public-facing, customer-oriented screens. Trustworthy blue tones with Korean readability first.
template.activity-feed.description: An activity feed whose protagonist is a single reverse-chronological vertical stream. Date-bucket grouping, a kind filter bar and load-more appending handle an open-ended flow.
template.admin.description: A sidebar-shell dashboard for admin/back-office use. Includes sortable tables, faceted filters, log/request/JSON observability viewers, and settings forms.
template.bank.description: A retail bank portal homepage. Composed of a hero carousel, quick-service tabs, promo cards, financial product categories, shortcuts, trending products, and news (fictional bank).
template.brokerage.description: A brokerage market home. A dense data terminal composed of a market indicator strip, live ranking screener, stock detail (candles, AI, community), and a watchlist sidebar (fictional brokerage).
template.chat.description: An AI assistant conversation screen. Composed of chat bubbles, a message scroller, an attachment input box + conversation list (mobile drawer), and model/prompt settings forms.
template.company-intel.description: A company intelligence dashboard that examines one fictional company in depth through KPI summaries, location, a news feed, an ownership/shareholder relation graph, and related keywords.
template.crawler-console.description: A data pipeline operations console with a crawl/update/detect step flow, run history table, and manual trigger with run/abort state transitions.
template.docker-container.description: An educational infographic explaining Docker's core concepts (Image, Container, Volume, Registry) through a meal-kit cooking analogy, with a build→run flow diagram and a symptom▶fix table.
template.elearning.description: A learning content player with a chapter-based lesson list, progress sidebar, 16:9 player, auto-advance countdown, and an AI summary modal.
template.glossary.description: A knowledge graph of 50 SDLC/AI terms woven into 6 categories and relations. A deterministic radial SVG constellation network with neighbor highlighting, search highlight, legend filters, and a detail panel.
template.knowledge-base.description: A team knowledge console combining a wiki document tree with markdown body and TOC, a kanban-style idea board, and a date-grouped session timeline in tabs.
template.kubernetes-firewall.description: An educational infographic explaining Kubernetes' four security layers (NetworkPolicy, Security Group, Ingress, OS Firewall) through an apartment-complex analogy, with the blueprint paper-grid look encapsulated in scoped CSS.
template.mail-workspace.description: A two-pane work screen where the list sits left, the detail right, and selecting swaps only the right pane without routing. Folder rail and search narrow the list; below lg it folds into a single pane.
template.market-report.description: A daily/weekly market report simulating news and disclosure analysis. Switches between a light daily view (ticker strip, event feed, risk matrix, watchlist) and a dark weekly view (theme ranking, timeline, calendar, disclosures) via profile re-scoping.
template.marketing-site.description: A marketing site with no sidebar: hero, features, how it works, pricing and FAQ flow vertically under a horizontal top nav. The skeleton that explains and leads to one action.
template.ontology.description: An ontology weaving 34 agent-infrastructure documents into 7 types and relations. Explores the same data through two tabs: a dictionary (search, type chips, highlight) and a deterministic force-layout SVG graph (neighbor highlighting, reference/back-reference detail panel).
template.rag-search.description: A RAG console that finds evidence with hybrid search and builds answers from it. Score breakdown across BM25, vector and rerank, sentence-level citations linked to source chunks, and indexing pipeline status are grouped into three tabs.
template.saas.description: A public-facing landing page (hero, features, pricing, FAQ) + dashboard + content feed. Composed of a view toggle, list controls, and card patterns.
template.shop.description: A storefront, product detail, and cart. Includes a product grid (faceted filter), image carousel, review summary, and checkout CTA.
template.trading.description: A trading dashboard giving an at-a-glance view of portfolio, quotes, and supply/demand. Combines financial gain/loss color tokens, eok/jo (Korean number units) formatting, sparklines, yield curves, diverging bars, and sortable tables.
